name: StreamableHTTPClientTransport
reason: The MCP SDK transport handle is only passed to the checked client.connect.

name: Client
reason: The MCP SDK client handle is only returned or passed along; each method on it is a checked effect.

name: ^new StreamableHTTPClientTransport$
reason: The SDK constructor receives the checked URL and fetch; the twin only passes the handle on.

name: ^new Client$
reason: The SDK constructor receives the checked client info and pinned protocol version.

name: ^client\.connect$
reason: The SDK performs the handshake; the twin branches only on whether it threw.

name: ^client\.getDiscoverResult$
reason: The SDK reports what the server's discover answered; the twin caches it as given.

name: ^client\.close$
reason: The SDK closes the transport and the code ignores its failure.

name: ^client\.listTools$
reason: The MCP server's listing is the outside answer.

name: ^operation$
reason: The caller's callback; the twin checks it gets the connected client and returns its answer.

name: ^isSpecType\.(Tool|ListToolsResult)$
reason: The MCP SDK's own schema guards over a remote answer; the twin acts on the boolean.

name: ^testOverrides\.listTools$
reason: A test-installed stub read from module state; the twin checks the connection it receives.

name: ^\$enter:arg[01]$
reason: Callbacks the instrumented sort and withClient enter; any effect they perform is checked.

name: ^AbortSignal\.timeout$
reason: The platform builds the signal from the checked constant and the twin only passes it on.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.mcp\.getById$
reason: The storage row is the outside answer, read by the checked account and server id.

name: ^storage\.sandboxConfigs\.list$
reason: The storage rows are the outside answer, read by the checked account.

name: ^storage\.agents\.listForStage$
reason: The storage rows are the outside answer, read by the checked account and stage.

name: apps/core/src/harness/mcp/client.ts#pruneCache
reason: Only evicts from a module Map and returns undefined, so no comparable twin exists.

name: ZodUnion

name: ^server\.setRequestHandler$
reason: The SDK stores the checked method name, schemas and handler.

name: ^createMcpHandler$

name: ^mcp\.fetch$
